observed.caption: A tall cylindrical tower with a circular observation deck at the top stands against a clear blue sky with people visible on the rooftop.
observed.description: A tall cylindrical high-rise building with alternating pinkish horizontal bands and dark window strips dominates the center of the image, topped by a wide flat circular observation platform with a dark underside and several small white dome-shaped objects on its roof. Small distant figures of people are standing along the railing of the rooftop deck. Behind the tower to the right is a beige rectangular building with a small yellow logo and text, and further to the right is another multi-story building with green signage and a low structure with a blue roof. A tall double-headed streetlight pole stands in the right foreground beside a light-colored elevated roadway or overpass that runs horizontally across the bottom of the image. The sky is clear and pale blue under bright daylight.
